$comment: The SDK channels published from this repository. Adding a channel is a one-line change here plus one `gjsify onboard` bootstrap for the new package name — npm Trusted Publishing can update a package but cannot create one, and the 404 it fails with reads like a broken trusted publisher.
$remotes: Per channel, because they do not all live in the same place: measured against the Flathub OSTree repo on 2026-09-05, stable `org.gnome.Sdk` ends at 50 — `master` is only on gnome-nightly, and 51 so far only as `51beta` on flathub-beta.
$gnome51: `@girs/sdk-gnome-51` is deliberately built from `51beta` until Flathub publishes the stable branch: the package name is what consumers depend on, and renaming it at release would break every dependency for the sake of eleven days. Its manifest says `sdk.branch: 51beta`, so what it was built from is never in doubt. When stable 51 lands, change `branch` to `51` and `remote` to `flathub` — the SDK commit changes with it and the channel rebuilds on the next run, with no bootstrap and no consumer change.
